kitDescription: Rosanna is an Electric machine-gun Burst-I attacker built around Concealment and Frenzy. Every 120 normal attacks she gains a brief Critical Rate buff (and refreshes a defensive Concealment state); every 500 normal attacks she adds a stacking Frenzy ATK buff that can build to 10 stacks. She passively deals extra damage whenever she has elemental advantage, so she is at her best against Water bosses. Her burst, Assalto, slams priority targets for a large single hit, deals a sizable bonus hit if she is concealed at cast time, and — against Water Code targets only — leaves a 30-second Damage Taken debuff that lifts the whole team's damage. The rest of her kit (enemy buff-strip, ally-death procs, gauge fill on ally death) is survival/PvP-flavored and does nothing in a boss DPS fight where nobody dies.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found. All 12 kit lines are either FAITHFUL (5 modeled: S1 crit 19.34%/3s unscoped at hitCount:120; S1 Elemental-Advantage 20% as passive elemAdvantageDamagePct routed to the measured ELEMENT bucket; S2 500-normal Frenzy at hitCount:500 x10/30s; burst Assalto 1310.4% burstCast FB-exempt; burst Water-gated Damage Taken 29%/30s boss-held team-wide) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (6 verbatim unmodeled out-of-domain lines + the ⚑1 concealment-gated 561.6% rider with estimate + recipe), and every modeled line carries a discriminating RED counterfactual (scoped-crit, always-on-DamageUp, passive-Frenzy, lvl-9 magnitude, ungated-Taken) plus two gap-honesty assertions against silent proxies. The S5-vs-driver convergence reads RED but every failure is fully attributed to blind-side harness-API bugs (unit-row .events instead of the onEvent stream; a nonexistent .blocks wrapper; mult-as-number) with zero driver encoding faults — RECON_ERRORs, not findings — and the S5 spec dispositions converge with the driver wherever they speak; S6's override is byte-identical on the two lines it models and convergent on the gap set. The systematic blind-side weakness is omission, not contradiction: all three blind roles missed R1 (Elemental Advantage 20%), R3 (500-normal Frenzy), and R5 (Water-gated Taken), each unambiguous in the prose and each verified here directly against Section 3 + the SSOT as faithful. The one substantive divergence (S2b's model-ungated 561.6% vs the driver's honest gap) is adjudicated in the driver's favor as protocol-correct (documented, estimated, recipe'd; corroborated 2-of-3 blinds) — but the same-model residual the owner should spot-check is precisely this: the sim's basis IS the no-damage boss, so in-domain concealment uptime is provably ≈100% and S2b's ungated + marker-assertion encoding would be exact on that basis; landing it is a cheap, principled ~+43%-burst upgrade the owner may greenlight. Secondary residuals: none on magnitudes (owner/measurement-gated, out of scope); the ⚑2 MG cadence tuple is an inherited datamine-default flag affecting proc counts only, not encodings. For GO nothing must change.
